protocol.selection: Second half validation only; first half used NN early stop. No TEST policy selection. Stable config order is recorded.
protocol.unknown_outcomes: Accepted unknown futures stay unresolved and invalidate selection; never excluded using outcome information.
protocol.accounting: Single shared spot USDT balance across four assets. Actual native M1 next-open entry, target cap, SL-first ambiguous bars. M1 marked drawdown.
limitations: Daily forecast origins, not intraday scanner frequency.
Historical spread unavailable; 0/5/15bp adverse price haircuts are assumptions.
Historical numerical fundamentals use assumed48h delay; historical full-news/LLM decisions were not backtested.
Many validation configurations; TEST is exposed by diagnostics and must not be reused for tuning.
